label: No PER_SE_5 esse regress from SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 and the efficiency bridge
meaning: The explicitly supplied efficiency bridge maps each distinct mode-unspecified actual esse cause to a present efficient cause at esse. Keep the given AsCaused conjunct to get a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 edge. The accessibility on that relation gives accessibility along its PER_SE_5 subrelation. The SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 premise may be assumed directly or obtained through the SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 inclusion. Its existing derivation from the target PER_SE_5 regress cannot provide independent support for that target.
